title: Income vs Expenses
summary: Learn the difference between money coming in and money going out.
concept:
Learn the difference between money coming in and money going out. Income is money received, while expenses are money spent. Comparing the two helps you understand whether you are living within your means.

In practice, this concept is useful because it changes how you compare choices instead of relying on instinct alone. Track income and expenses over the same period. A positive gap means income is higher than expenses. Tracking is the first step toward budgeting.

title: Inflation & Purchasing Power
summary: Understand why the same amount of money can buy less over time.
concept:
